rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: Sunday/Holiday branch treated any worked hours < half-day dept threshold as WO/H even when both punches existed; and the Research Unit half-day threshold was 6h which excluded Sanjay's 5h 1m worked shift from HD. Fix (already implemented by main agent): (a) Research Unit half-day threshold reduced to 5h; (b) Sunday/Holiday classifier now returns HD/FD when hours cross thresholds, MP for incomplete punches, WO when hours < half. weekoff_value=1 preserved on Sundays regardless. extra_pay stays a separate column and is not folded into final_payable_days (formula = working + weekoff + oh - lop). Verification via this suite confirms all cases pass.
